raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week General Strength Program for Desk Worker with Prior L4-L5 Herniation" plus Nutrition
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Develop general strength with spine-friendly loading, avoiding heavy spinal flexion and loaded flexion"

RECOVERY
  SLEEP_RECOVERY
    SLEEP_TARGETS:
      - duration_nightly 7.5..9 hours
      - consistent_bedtime_window 22:00..23:30
      - caffeine_cutoff_before_noon
    PRE_SLEEP_RITUAL:
      - light_stretch 5 minutes
      - 1 minute breathing_box_breathing
      - dim_lighting 30 minutes before bed
    SLEEP_ENVIRONMENT:
      - dark_room true
      - cool_temperature 18..20C
      - quiet true
  REST_DRAWS
    - weekly deload or active recovery day every 4 weeks
    - monitor perceived recovery (0-10 scale) and modify if <5 on two consecutive weeks
  RECOVERY_ACTIVITIES
    - mobility_flow 10 minutes, 3x/week (gentle hips, thoracic spine)
    - walks 20-30 minutes, 3x/week (low intensity)
    - foam_roll or self-myofascial release 5-10 minutes, 2x/week

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body Foundations":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          anti_inflammatory_abs_safe 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Thursday cardio 30m "Cardio A":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main:
          cycling 30 minutes rpe 6
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progressive Strength Build - Push Intensity Upshift":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x8..12 each side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          safe_abs_progression 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_m.diving_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Thursday cardio 30m "Cardio B":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main:
          rowing 30 minutes rpe 6
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength Peak with Spine-Friendly Loading - Push Intensity Maintained":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          back_squat_alternative 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x8..12 each side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Thursday cardio 35m "Cardio Focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main:
          elliptical 25 minutes + incline_walk 10 minutes
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds

TESTING
  FINAL_1RM
    description "Final week testing 1RM for safe lifts with clinical clearance"
    test_lifts:
      - bench_press 1RM
      - incline_press 1RM
      - barbell_row 1RM
      - goblet_squat 1RM
    protocol_instructions:
      - warmup sets: 5-10 minutes total; gradually ramp to work sets
      - use RPE targets: warmups 5-6, work 8-9
      - ensure spine-friendly cues; no maximal spinal loading
      - requires clinician clearance if any pain arises

NUTRITION
  NUTRITION GOALS
    GOAL primary inflammation_reduction:
      name "Anti-inflammatory eating pattern to support training recovery and general health"

  NUTRITION PLAN
    DAILY_EATING_PATTERN:
      name "Anti-inflammatory plate approach"
      description "Prioritize whole foods, colorful vegetables, lean proteins, healthy fats, and whole grains. Limit highly processed foods, added sugars, and pro-inflammatory fats."
    MACRO_GUIDANCE:
      protein_target 1.6x body_weight_kg grams_per_day
      fat_target 0.8x body_weight_kg grams_per_day
      carbohydrate_target remaining calories to meet total energy needs
    FOOD_NEEDS:
      - lean_protein: ["chicken_breast", "turkey", "fish", "egg_whites", "tofu", "legumes"]
      - vegetables: ["broccoli", "spinach", "mixed_leafy_greens", "bell_peppers", "tomatoes", "carrots"]
      - fruits: ["berries", "apples", "oranges"]
      - whole_grains: ["oats", "brown_rice", "quinoa", "barley"]
      - healthy_fats: ["olive_oil", "avocado", "nuts", "seeds", "fatty_fish"]
      - dairy_or_alternative: ["greek_yogurt", "cottage_cheese", "plant_based_milk"]
    ANTI_INFLAMMATORY_FOODS:
      - berries
      - fatty_fish (salmon, sardines)
      - leafy_greens
      - olive_oil
      - turmeric/ginger (as spices)
      - green_tea
    FOODS_TO_LIMIT:
      - processed_snack_foods
      - sugar_sweetened_beverages
      - refined_carbohydrates
      - fried_foods
      - red_and_processed_meats

  NUTRITION_LOGGING
    frequency daily
    notes "Track meals to ensure adherence to anti-inflammatory choices. Prioritize protein distribution across meals."

  SUPPLEMENTATION_ADVICE
    note "Supplement only if dietary gaps exist; consult clinician. Common considerations: vitamin D3 in low sun, omega-3 from fish oil, and magnesium if needed for sleep."

  SAFETY_AND_ADJUSTMENTS
    note "Maintain spine-friendly loading in training; avoid heavy spinal flexion. Hydration and sleep targets support recovery."

ABS_WORK
  ABS_ROUTINE_SAFE
    description "Safe core work focused on endurance and stability without spinal flexion loading."
    EXERCISES:
      - plank 3x30 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
      - side_plank 3x20 seconds each side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
      - dead_bug 3x10 per side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
      - bird_dog 3x12 per side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
      - hollow_hold 3x20 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds

  ABS_PROGRESSIONS
    - progression: increase hold time by 5-10 seconds every 2 weeks if tolerated
    - note: avoid full sit-ups, hanging leg raises, or spinal flexion with load

  SAFETY_NOTES_ABS
    - maintain neutral spine
    - if any back pain, stop and consult clinician

END PLAN
